Set tracking and rest timer

↗ BUILT FOR APPLE WATCH＋ OPTIONAL APPLE HEALTH○ NO ACCOUNT. NO ADS.

Features

Set and rest tracking

Record sets and manage rest periods directly on your watch.

01 / LOG

Record sets

Tap Finish set to record a completed set and start the rest timer. Track sets across multiple exercises.

02 / REST

Adjust rest periods

Choose a rest duration, add 30 seconds, or skip the remaining rest. Enable haptic and sound alerts in Settings.

03 / REPEAT

Advance exercises

Move to the next exercise yourself, or let Chromeset advance after your chosen number of sets.

Session history

Review saved workouts

History shows your saved sessions, including set count, exercise count, duration, and recorded active calories. Session records are stored locally on your watch.

Optional Apple Health integration

With your permission, record strength workouts and see heart rate and active energy during your session. Health and location access are optional.

Support and privacy
